definitions.gloss: ATM; automated teller machine; cash machine
definitions.explanation: an electronic banking machine that allows customers to withdraw cash, check balances, and perform other banking transactions without a teller

examples.japanese: ATM⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧。
examples.english: I withdraw money from the ATM.

examples.english: Convenience store ATMs can be used 24 hours a day.

notes:
DAILY VOCABULARY:
ATM (エーティーエム) machines are ubiquitous in Japan, found in banks, convenience stores (⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧), post offices (⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧), and shopping centers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ATM⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧/⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧ - withdraw money from ATM
- ATM⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入金|にゅうきん}→入金：05467_nyuukin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - deposit money at ATM
- ATM⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧ - ATM fees
- ATM⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ - ATM area

PRACTICAL NOTE:
Japanese ATMs often have limited hours at banks but are available 24 hours at convenience stores. International cards may not work at all ATMs—look for machines at post offices (⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧) or 7-Eleven for better compatibility.
